props.html:
Enquiry received

Thank you — your brief is with us

We've got your details, and a confirmation is on its way to your inbox. Your request has been passed to My Event Match so our florists can review it.

  1. 01We review and matchWe hand-match your brief to florists who cover your area, work in your style and are free on your date.
  2. 02Florists respond to youYou'll start hearing back with approaches and pricing, usually within one to two business days.
  3. 03You compare and chooseReview the proposals side by side and book directly with the studio that feels right. No obligation either way.
Browse real weddings Read the pricing guide

Nifty setup: this is the redirect target for every lead form on the site. Add the conversion tag (GA4 / Google Ads / Meta) to this page only, so one submission is counted once.
